claims: Continue CRRT with current prescription and monitor filter pressures, fluid balance, and electrolytes.
Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings and monitor airway pressures, tidal volumes, and ABGs.
Continue vasopressor infusions (norepinephrine, vasopressin, epinephrine, phenylephrine) and titrate to MAP goal while monitoring hemodynamics.
Transfuse packed red blood cells and recheck hemoglobin/hematocrit after transfusion.
Continue broad-spectrum antibiotics (cefepime, vancomycin, aztreonam) and monitor for clinical improvement and culture results.
Monitor and correct severe metabolic acidosis (pH 7.16-7.23, bicarbonate 9-12, lactate 9-12.8) with serial ABGs and electrolyte replacement.
Monitor coagulation parameters (INR 2.4-2.7, PTT 46-54, platelets 50-112, fibrinogen 97-163) and manage bleeding risk.
Replete electrolytes including calcium gluconate, potassium chloride, and magnesium based on serial labs.
Obtain repeat blood cultures and monitor for sepsis response given persistent shock and lactic acidosis.
Maintain sedation with propofol and fentanyl infusions, targeting RASS goal, and reassess neurologic status.
